page.layout: One page with two columns of an index, set under a title block at the top. The title block is a centred heading in capitals with an italic subtitle below it. Left column: letters A to E and their entries. Right column: continuation of E, then F to I. Under the right column is a gathering signature at the lower right. No running head, no page number, no catchword.

main_text.head: INDEX TITULORUM
SEU RUBRICARUM QUATUOR librorum Institutionum,in quo numerus prior titulum, alter librum, tertius vero paginam designat.
main_text.l: Ademptione legatorum, & translatione eorum Tit. lib.2.79.
Attiliano tutore,& eo qui ex lege Iulia & Titia dabatur Tit.20.lib.1.22.

Hæreditatibus quę ab intestato deferuntur[?] Tit. 1. lib. 3.88.
His qui sui vel alieni iuris sunt Tit.8.lib.1.10.

page.notes: The title block is set in large capitals with an italic subtitle. The large initial A of "ADquisitione" is joined to its word as printed. The word "de" before that initial stands on the same line. The entry "Bonorum possessionibus" has "Tit." with no number on the page, as printed. The word "deferuntur" in the entry Hæreditatibus is partly obscured by a ligature and is uncertain. The entry "Excusationibus'" has a printed apostrophe. The gathering signature at the lower right is only partly legible. Stains and show-through at the foot of the page are not transcribed.
